question: The dance-pavilion (mandapa), the vast complex within a quadrilateral precinct of the Odisha school of architecture, is known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagmohana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** dance-pavilion (mandapa) in the Odisha school of architecture is known as the Jaganmohan.**
 
• The Jaganmohan is a **large enclosed space made of black granite** that is said to be the largest in Hindu architecture.
 
• **Mandapas**
 
 
• In Indian temple architecture, **a mandapa is a pillared hall or pavilion for rituals.**
 
• Mandapas can be open or closed, depending on whether they have walls. 
 
 
 
• **Odisha school of architecture**
 
• **Also known as the Kalinga school of temple architecture, this style of Hindu architecture is characterized by three types of temples: Rekha Deul, Pidha Deul, and Khakhara Deul. **
 
• **Shikhar**a
 
 
• In Odisha, the shikhara is called the deul.
 
• It is almost vertical until the top, where it bends sharply inwards
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vimana:** A tower that sits above the inner sanctum, or garbhagriha, of a Hindu temple.
 
• **Vimanas are usually pyramid-shaped and have multiple stories.**
 
• In South Indian temples, the vimana is often smaller than the gopuram, which is the main entrance gateway.
 
• In Odisha temples, t**he vimana is the tallest structure in the temple. **
 
• **Gopuram**: A large entrance gateway that sits in the center of the front wall of a Hindu temple.
 
• **Gopurams are one of the most striking architectural features of a temple complex**. 
 
• Deul: A Hindu temple
